_comment: EventBridge Scheduled Rule — EBS Snapshot Backup every day at 12:00 PM UTC (5:30 PM IST)
_deploy_instructions: This file is used by deploy.sh — do not apply manually

rule.Name: pip-project-ecommerce-ebs-backup-schedule
rule.Description: Trigger EBS snapshot backup Lambda daily at 12:00 PM UTC (5:30 PM IST). Chosen to avoid the 03:00 UTC maintenance window and 02:00 UTC secrets rotation.

target._comment_schedule: cron(0 12 * * ? *) = 12:00 UTC every day = 5:30 PM IST

_schedule_options.dry_run_test: rate(5 minutes)       — for testing only, change Input to {"dry_run": true}
_schedule_options.weekly_sunday: cron(0 12 ? * SUN *)  — weekly instead of daily (lower cost)
